Name: Transthyretin
Comments: Amyloidosis is enhanced by mutants that destabilise the quaternary structure, including V30M and V122I.

Name: Beta-2-microglobulin
Comments: Besides aggregating im long-term dialysis patients, hereditary amyloidosis is driven by stability-reducing mutants, particularly D96N.

Name: IAPP
Comments: The mature IAPP peptide displays a disulfide bridge and a C-terminal amidation

Name: Gelsolin
Comments: Pathogenic gelsolin mutants (D187N, D187Y). Aggregates are composed of 8 kDa and 5k Da fragments corresponding to amino acids 173-242 and 173-225, respectively).
